title: Group routes in a plugin
summary: Fastify: Group routes in a plugin. Add another route inside the plugin.
introduction: register gives a plugin its own scope. A prefix puts its routes under /api. Open GET /api/books.
learningObjectives: Group routes in a plugin with Fastify

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install fastify@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000 and stop each server before the next example.

blocks.title: Group routes in a plugin

blocks.text: The plugin owns /books under its /api prefix, so the combined route matches.
Add another route inside the plugin.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The plugin prefix is part of the final URL.
